articles.title: How to Boost Court Bookings During Off-Peak Hours
articles.excerpt: Empty courts at noon don't have to stay empty. Here are practical pricing and promotion tactics that fill quiet hours.
body: Every sports facility has them: the quiet hours between the morning rush and the evening peak, when courts sit empty and revenue flatlines. The good news is that off-peak demand exists — it just needs the right incentive to show up.

Start with dynamic pricing. Offering 20–40% discounts on midday and early-afternoon slots attracts students, shift workers, and remote employees who have flexible schedules. With Court+, you can configure time-based pricing rules once and let the platform apply them automatically.

Next, bundle quiet hours into memberships and corporate packages. Companies increasingly look for team-building activities, and a weekly reserved slot at a discounted rate is an easy sell. Academies and coaches also love consistent off-peak blocks for training sessions.

Finally, promote the slots where players already are: push notifications and in-app offers convert far better than social media posts. A well-timed 'afternoon deal' notification sent through Court+ reaches players who have already booked with you before — the audience most likely to book again.

articles.title: 5 Ways to Improve Player Experience at Your Venue
articles.excerpt: Winning venues aren't just about great courts — the whole journey from booking to post-match matters.
body: Player experience is the strongest driver of repeat bookings. A player who enjoys the full journey — from finding your venue to leaving after a match — becomes a regular, and regulars are the backbone of facility revenue.

First, make booking effortless. If reserving a court takes a phone call, you are losing the generation of players who expect to book in three taps. Second, keep your schedule accurate: nothing damages trust like arriving to a double-booked court.

Third, invest in the small details on site — clean changing rooms, working lights, water availability, and clear signage. Fourth, close the payment loop digitally so players never fumble with cash or bank transfers after a match.

Fifth, listen. Collect ratings and reviews after each booking, respond to complaints quickly, and let players see that feedback changes things. Court+ gives you reviews, notifications, and customer history in one place, so every visit can be a little better than the last.

articles.title: A New Way to Manage Courts
articles.excerpt: Spreadsheets and phone bookings got you this far. Here's what a modern operating system for your facility looks like.
body: For years, running a sports facility meant a notebook by the phone, a wall calendar, and a lot of patience. Those tools worked when demand was local and predictable. They break down the moment your facility grows beyond a single court and a single employee.

A modern court management platform replaces scattered tools with one source of truth. Availability, pricing, bookings, payments, staff roles, and customer records live in a single dashboard that is always in sync with what players see in the app.

The impact is immediate: no more double bookings, no more end-of-month revenue mysteries, and no more depending on one person who 'knows the schedule'. Owners see occupancy and revenue in real time, and staff spend their time serving players instead of answering booking calls.
Court+ was built exactly for this transition — bringing facilities in Saudi Arabia from paper to platform without disrupting daily operations. Onboarding takes minutes, not weeks.

articles.title: Why Online Payments Are a Game-Changer for Facilities
articles.excerpt: Cash no-shows and unpaid reservations quietly drain revenue. Digital payments fix both — and unlock new insights.
body: Ask any facility owner about their biggest frustration and 'no-shows' comes up quickly. A player who reserves by phone and never arrives costs you the slot and the revenue. Online prepayment changes the economics completely.

When players pay at booking time, no-show rates collapse. Even a partial deposit makes players dramatically more committed to showing up — and if they cancel early enough, the slot can be resold automatically.

Digital payments also clean up your accounting. Every riyal is tracked, reconciled, and reported automatically. Refunds, wallet credits, and invoices stop being manual chores and become one-click operations.

With Court+, facilities get secure payment processing, automatic invoicing, and real-time revenue dashboards out of the box — fully aligned with the way players in Saudi Arabia already expect to pay: from their phone.

articles.title: The Padel Boom in Saudi Arabia — and How to Ride It
articles.excerpt: Padel is the fastest-growing sport in the Kingdom. Here's how facility owners can capture the opportunity.
body: Few sports have grown in Saudi Arabia like padel. In just a few years, courts have multiplied across Riyadh, Jeddah, and the Eastern Province, and prime-time slots in major cities sell out days in advance.

For facility owners, the boom is both an opportunity and a challenge. Demand is high, but so is competition — new courts open every month. The venues that win are the ones that are easiest to find, easiest to book, and most consistent in quality.

Visibility starts with being where players search. A facility listed on a booking platform gets discovered by players who have never driven past it. Instant booking and transparent pricing then convert that discovery into a reservation.

Court+ helps padel venues manage the full cycle: real-time availability across multiple courts, prime-time pricing rules, memberships for regulars, and analytics that show exactly which hours and courts earn the most.

articles.title: Using Data to Increase Facility Revenue
articles.excerpt: Your booking history is a goldmine. Learn how occupancy and revenue analytics turn guesses into decisions.
body: Most facility owners can tell you their busiest evening. Far fewer can tell you their occupancy rate by hour, their revenue per court, or which customer segment books the most. That gap between intuition and data is where revenue hides.

Occupancy analytics reveal underused capacity — the specific hours, days, and courts that need promotion or repricing. Revenue analytics reveal what is actually working: which offers convert, which courts justify premium pricing, and how seasonal demand shifts.

Customer analytics might be the most valuable of all. Identifying your top 50 players by booking volume lets you protect that loyalty with memberships and perks. Spotting players who stopped booking lets you win them back before a competitor does.
Court+ turns every booking into a data point, and every data point into a decision you can act on — occupancy, revenue, and customer trends, updated in real time on your dashboard.

items.question: What is Court+?
items.answer: Court+ is a smart platform for booking and managing sports courts. Players discover and book courts instantly, and facility owners manage bookings, payments, and operations from one dashboard.

items.question: How do I create an account?
items.answer: Download the Court+ app or visit our website, click Sign Up, and follow the instructions to enter your details.

items.question: Is the app free to use?
items.answer: Yes, the Court+ app is free to download and use for browsing and booking sports facilities.

items.question: Which sports are supported?
items.answer: Court+ supports a variety of sports including padel, football, tennis, basketball, and more. Check the app for full details.

items.question: Is Court+ available in my city?
items.answer: Court+ is launching across Saudi Arabia, starting with major cities. Enter your location in the app to see nearby facilities.

items.question: How do I list my facility?
items.answer: Sign up as an owner and follow the onboarding process to add your facility details, courts, pricing, and schedule.

items.question: Can I manage multiple branches under one account?
items.answer: Yes, Court+ allows owners to manage several branches and all their courts from one dashboard.

items.question: How do I track payments and bookings?
items.answer: The dashboard provides detailed analytics, payment logs, and booking history in real time.

items.question: How do I book a court?
items.answer: Search for facilities in the app, select a time slot, and complete the booking with secure in-app payment.

items.question: Can I join matches with other players?
items.answer: Yes — you can create your own matches and invite friends, or join public matches near you.

items.question: What payment methods are accepted?
items.answer: We accept mada, credit and debit cards, Apple Pay, and select digital wallets.

items.question: Is my payment information secure?
items.answer: Yes. Payments are processed through secure, certified payment gateways — Court+ never stores your full card details.

items.question: How do I contact support?
items.answer: Use the in-app chat or email support@courtplusapp.com — our team responds within 24 hours.

items.question: Do you store my card information?

items.question: Is there a service fee?

items.question: How do I contact support?
items.answer: Use in-app chat or email support@courtplusapp.com for assistance.

items.question: My app is not loading. What should I do?
items.answer: Try restarting the app, updating it, or checking your internet connection.

items.question: I didn’t receive a confirmation email or SMS.
items.answer: Check your spam folder or update your phone number/email in your profile.

items.question: The app keeps crashing. How do I fix it?
items.answer: Clear cache, reinstall the app, or ensure your device software is up to date.

items.question: My booking is not showing in the app.
items.answer: Log out and log back in, or contact support if the issue persists.

items.question: I’m having trouble with payments.
items.answer: Make sure your card is valid and try again. If the issue continues, contact support.

privacy_page.hero_subtitle: Court+ (“we”, “our”, or “us”) is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information when you use our website, mobile app, and related services, in line with Saudi Arabia's Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL). By using Court+, you agree to this Privacy Policy.

items.question: Account information
items.answer: When you create an account, we collect your name, email address, phone number, and password, along with optional profile details such as your photo and preferred sports.

items.question: Booking information
items.answer: We keep records of your reservations, including the facility, court, date and time, payment status, and your cancellation and refund history.

items.question: Payment information
items.answer: Payments are processed by licensed third-party payment providers. We receive confirmation of the transaction and the payment method used, but we never store your full card number or security code.

items.question: Location data
items.answer: With your permission, we use your device's location to show sports facilities near you. You can disable location access at any time from your device settings.

items.question: Device and usage data
items.answer: We automatically collect technical data such as your device type, operating system, app version, IP address, and how you interact with the app and website, using cookies and similar technologies.

items.question: Facility owner information
items.answer: If you register as a facility owner, we also collect business details such as the facility name, commercial registration information, and bank account details used for payouts.

items.question: Providing our services
items.answer: We use your data to create and manage your account, process bookings and payments, and connect you with sports facilities.

items.question: Communication
items.answer: We send booking confirmations, reminders, and service updates, and we use your contact details to respond to your support requests.

items.question: Improving Court+
items.answer: We analyze how the platform is used to improve performance, fix issues, and develop new features that make booking and managing courts easier.

items.question: Marketing
items.answer: With your consent, we may send you offers and news about Court+. You can opt out of marketing messages at any time from your account settings or the unsubscribe link.

items.question: Safety and legal compliance
items.answer: We use your data to verify identity, prevent fraud and misuse of the platform, and comply with applicable laws and requests from competent authorities in Saudi Arabia.

items.question: Where your data is stored
items.answer: Your data is stored on secure cloud servers. Where data is transferred or stored outside Saudi Arabia, we do so only in accordance with the requirements of the Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL).

items.question: How we protect your data
items.answer: We use industry-standard safeguards, including encryption of data in transit and at rest, strict access controls, and continuous monitoring. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, but we work to protect your data at all times.

items.question: How long we keep your data
items.answer: We keep your personal data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide our services, and afterwards only for the period required by applicable laws, such as tax and accounting regulations. Data that is no longer needed is deleted or anonymized.

items.question: Account deletion
items.answer: You can request deletion of your account through the app or by contacting support. We will delete or anonymize your personal data unless we are legally required to keep certain records.

items.question: Payment providers
items.answer: Payments are handled by licensed payment gateways that process your payment details under their own privacy policies and security standards.

items.question: Service providers
items.answer: We work with trusted providers for cloud hosting, analytics, and communications such as SMS and email. They may only process your data on our instructions and are bound by confidentiality obligations.

items.question: Sports facilities
items.answer: When you book a court, we share with the facility the details needed to fulfill your booking, such as your name and the booking time. Facilities may not use this information for any other purpose.

items.question: We do not sell your data
items.answer: Court+ never sells or rents your personal information to third parties.

items.question: External links
items.answer: Our website and app may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for their content or privacy practices, so we encourage you to review their policies.

items.question: Your rights under Saudi law
items.answer: Under the Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL), you have the right to know how your data is processed, to access it, to request its correction, and to request its deletion when it is no longer needed.

items.question: Access and correction
items.answer: You can view and update most of your information directly from your profile in the app, or ask us for a copy of the personal data we hold about you.

items.question: Deletion
items.answer: You can ask us to delete your personal data. We will honor your request unless we are required to keep certain data by law.

items.question: Withdrawing consent
items.answer: Where processing is based on your consent — such as marketing messages or location access — you can withdraw it at any time without affecting your use of the core service.

items.question: How to exercise your rights
items.answer: Contact us at support@courtplusapp.com. We may need to verify your identity before acting on your request, and we will respond within the timeframes required by law.

items.question: Complaints
items.answer: If you believe your data has been mishandled, you can contact us first, and you also have the right to file a complaint with the competent data protection authority in Saudi Arabia.

items.question: How to reach us
items.answer: For any questions about this Privacy Policy or your personal data, email us at support@courtplusapp.com or use the in-app support chat — our team responds within 24 hours.

items.question: Changes to this policy
items.answer: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. If we make material changes, we will notify you through the app, website, or email before the changes take effect.

items.question: Effective date
items.answer: This Privacy Policy was last updated in July 2026 and applies to all users of the Court+ website, mobile app, and related services.
